title: Gemini gained built-in tools
summary:
Gemini picked up built-in tools while the community catalog grew across stories, art, video, coding, and everyday utilities.

The chat API added support for Gemini’s code execution, Google Search, Google Maps, URL context, computer use, and file search tools alongside OpenAI-style function tools. Requests to `gemini` get code execution, Google Search, and URL context by default when no tools are supplied; explicit tool choices take precedence.

The community project listings added NIKKE roleplay with animated characters, illustrated story makers, a historical time-travel experience, and tools for building choice-based games and D&D characters. Two PRs each listed NIKKE and Kinexus; those are two projects, not four. A Gorilla Tag mod menu with a Pollinations-powered assistant also joined the games listings.

New community listings span browser-based image studios, a Telegram art bot, a multi-style image generator, and Viral Flow, which uses generated visuals in browser-based video production.

highlights.title: Gemini gets built-in tools
highlights.text: Pass Gemini built-in tools such as `google_search`, `code_execution`, and `url_context` alongside function tools. Requests to `gemini` use those three by default when you supply no tools; explicit choices take precedence. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
